header.title: How to Convert a Gas BBQ to Propane
header.description: This guide details the process of converting a gas-powered barbecue grill to use propane fuel. It provides step-by-step instructions for modifying the regulator and connections to safely utilize propane.

steps.description: Remove the cap on the pressure regulator using a flat-head screwdriver and ensure it's marked 'LP'.
actions: Turn the cap on the pressure regulator
